messages:
Rae (PM): Quick sync: propose scheduled onboarding windows grouped by GPU family + region to cut benchmarking noise and reduce infra churn. Short plan below.

Jun (Eng-ML): Agreed. Bench slices should include chat (<=128), docs (128-1024), long (1024-2048). Also sample KV-cache hit rates.

Priya (Infra): Ops: we'll add manifest fields `preferred_gpu_family` and `region_window`. During windows disable startup-burst autoscaling and reserve pools to avoid noisy scale-ups.

Omar (ProdOps): Pin/migration policy question: default defer migrations to a tenant's next matching window? Allow immediate opt-in via support ticket?

Rae (PM): Yes. Default = schedule migration to next matching hardware/region window. Immediate opt-in allowed with `migration_accelerate` tag; forced deferral configurable up to 90 days for legacy contracts.

Nina (Solutions): Customers want a short migration checklist: tokenizer parity, response-shape tests, known perf delta, and recommended rollout guardrails. I'll draft a one-pager.

onboard-bot: Runbook template created: gpu-window-onboard-2026-v1, owners: @Rae, @Jun, @Priya.

Jun (Eng-ML): Add a quality gate: 5% A/B holdback for 7 days; fail if eval delta > 2% on key slices. Also run KV-cache correctness smoke tests.

Priya (Infra): Fallback policy: if reserved pool saturates route to compatible variant with `degraded-perf` flag and page #eng-oncall. Document expected p95 delta thresholds.

Rae (PM): Action items: finalize calendar by Friday (Rae), bench matrix + harness (Jun), autoscaler prototype (Priya), migration ticket template (Omar), customer FAQ (Nina). I'll draft the runbook and ping for reviews.

Omar (ProdOps): I'll create the migration ticket template and tagging conventions.

Jun (Eng-ML): Opening PR for eval harness today.

Priya (Infra): I'll prototype staging autoscaler tweaks and post perf snapshots mid-week.

Rae (PM): Thanks everyone — will publish runbook draft when PRs link in. :thumbsup:
